title: Python requirement pinned to a local version label
description: requirements.txt declares a pin carrying a `+local` version label. A local label names a build that the public index does not necessarily serve, so the pin resolves only against a specific wheel source.
remediation: Pin the public version, or record the wheel source and its hash in the requirements file.
limitation: It matches a pin carrying a `+local` version label in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
